inputs.goal: list the spring hardware line on Amazon under its claims policy

write.listing_copy: Spring Hardware Line - Amazon's comprehensive selection of spring hardware components including compression springs, extension springs, torsion springs, and custom spring solutions. All products meet Amazon's strict quality standards and marketplace policies. Features include: high-grade materials for durability, precise manufacturing tolerances, and compliance with industry safety standards. Available in various sizes, loads, and configurations to suit diverse application needs. Backed by Amazon's warranty and customer service support. Product specifications available upon request. Complies with all applicable marketplace policies including safety requirements, material sourcing standards, and labeling regulations.
